what_it_can_establish: Content identity/integrity against an expected digest
what_it_does_not_establish: Trusted origin, approval, secure build, absence of malicious behavior
policy_use: Pin and compare immutable artifact identities.

question_answered: Did the expected signing identity sign this artifact/statement?
what_it_can_establish: Signature validity plus signer identity when verifier checks key/certificate expectations
what_it_does_not_establish: That signer is approved, artifact is safe, build source/parameters were approved

question_answered: Where/how/by what builder and inputs was it produced?
what_it_can_establish: Authenticated build metadata bound to artifact subject
what_it_does_not_establish: That all claims satisfy buyer expectations or builder itself is uncompromised
policy_use: Verify subject, builder, source, build type and parameters against policy.

question_answered: Does the evidence match our approved deployment?
policy_use: Fail closed on required unknown/mismatch/unexpected components.
